title: Contract definition
description: A contract offer's authored terms. Ranges here are the same numbers ContentBounds enforces in the loader; SchemaAgreementTests asserts the two never drift apart.

schema_version.description: Version of this content format (TDD 11.1). Pinned by const so a file authored for a later format is refused by tooling, not read under today's assumptions; ContentSet.SupportedContentSchemaVersion states the same number and SchemaAgreementTests keeps the two equal.

id.description: Stable namespaced identifier; the pattern is ContentId's own format.

display_name_key.description: Localization key, never a player-facing literal (TDD 11.1). The pattern is the artifact-safe character set: this key travels unchanged into HeroState and from there into the canonical determinism artifact, where non-ASCII text and control characters are exactly the inputs the frozen corpus records the C# writer and RFC 8785 disagreeing on.

tags.description: Tags a hero's traits can react to (HERO_DECISION_SPEC §1.4).

negotiable_tags.description: Exactly two mutually exclusive method tags the player chooses one of (NEGOTIATION_SPEC 2.4). Absent means the contract is negotiated on money and promise only.
